def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    cities = d["cities"]
    arcs = d["arcs"]
    net = d["net"]
    city_cap = d["city_cap"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=cities)
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=list(arcs.keys()), dimen=2)

    # flow[i,j]: units shipped on arc (i,j), bounded by link capacity
    def flow_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, arcs[(i, j)][1])

    model.flow = pyo.Var(
        model.A,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=flow_bounds,
    )

    # Objective: minimize total transportation cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(arcs[(i, j)][0] * m.flow[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Flow balance: outflow - inflow = net supply
    def balance_rule(m, k):
        out_flow = sum(m.flow[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if i == k)
        in_flow = sum(m.flow[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        return out_flow - in_flow == net[k]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=balance_rule)

    # City capacity: total inflow into city k <= city_cap[k]
    def city_cap_rule(m, k):
        return sum(m.flow[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k) <= city_cap[k]

    model.city_capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=city_cap_rule)

    return model

    # City capacity: total inflow cannot exceed city capacity
    def city_cap_rule(m, i):
        return sum(m.x[j, i] for (j, k) in arcs if k == i) <= city_cap[i]

    model.city_cap_con = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=city_cap_rule)

    # Objective: minimize total transportation cost
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=sum(cost[(i, j)] * model.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs),
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    return model
